phases: Phase 1: qor/scripts/plan_absolute_claim_lint.py -- flags an absolute claim in a Locked Decision that carries neither paired grep-evidence nor an inline scope qualifier, and flags evidence narrower than the claim it backs; reuses plan_evidence's statement parser and _ld_blocks region; helper names avoid validator prefixes because qor/scripts is scanned by a composition lint with an empty allowlist

Phase 2: make the recurrence machine-visible -- add scope-overgeneralization to the audit findings_categories enum, scope_overgeneralization to the shadow event_type enum, and a matching rule to remediate_pattern_match.PATTERN_RULES ranked below gate-loop, so a third occurrence fires the escalator that already exists

Phase 3: doctrine and wiring -- a new SG entry citing qor.scripts.plan_absolute_claim_lint as its enforcer, one glossary term with a non-empty referenced_by, and one WARN-only ladder line in /qor-audit Step 0.6 within a measured 1,709-byte margin to the skill size EXCEEDED threshold

limitations: The lint reads plan Markdown only; it cannot tell whether an absolute claim is true, only whether the plan pairs it with evidence or a scope qualifier.
Detection is lexical: a claim phrased without any listed quantifier is invisible to it.
WARN-only in V1, matching how skill_size_budget_lint and procedural_fidelity shipped.
non_goals: Judging the truth of any claim.
Any change to /qor-audit's verdict rules or the existing pre-audit lints.
exclusions: The three Phase 258 plan-text corrections named in META_LEDGER entry #730.
Capture-time tree state and declared-versus-actual scope fidelity (GH #434), answered on the boundary and sequenced behind this phase.
GH #436's auditor-amendment clauses; filed, not built here.

feature_inventory_touches.test_descriptor: qor-logic scripts plan_absolute_claim_lint exits 1 naming absolute-claim-unevidenced for an unbacked absolute claim in a Locked Decision and absolute-claim-unqualified when the paired evidence is narrower than the claim, and exits 0 on a plan whose absolute claims all carry evidence or a stated scope
